purpose.zh: 用离心加强腘绳肌，提升后侧力量和抗拉伤能力
purpose.en: Strengthen the hamstrings eccentrically for back-of-leg strength and resilience.

text.zh: 膝到头一条直线，尽量慢地向前下放
text.en: Keep a line from knees to head and lower forward as slowly as you can

text.zh: 脚跟扣紧，双手护在胸前
text.en: Hook your heels in and keep your hands up in front of your chest.

text.zh: 腘绳肌发力，控制着把身体拉回直立
text.en: Use your hamstrings to pull yourself back upright with control.

commonErrors.en: Bending at the hips and sticking the butt out.

commonErrors.zh: 一下子摔下去，失去控制
commonErrors.en: Dropping down fast and losing control.

cautions.zh: 初学者只做小幅离心；腘绳肌拉伤史者先咨询专业人士
cautions.en: Beginners should lower only a little; if you have had a hamstring strain, check with a professional first.
